title.zh: Authors Pull Ethereum Staking Reward Burn From Hegotá
title.en: Authors Pull Ethereum Staking Reward Burn From Hegotá

current_state.zh: Ethereum's staking reward burn proposal was pulled from the Hegotá upgrade after objections over validator economics and process, with authors now pursuing a standalone issuance-policy process and Lido among those volunteering to assist.
current_state.en: Ethereum's staking reward burn proposal was pulled from the Hegotá upgrade after objections over validator economics and process, with authors now pursuing a standalone issuance-policy process and Lido among those volunteering to assist.
